title: AI + Programming for Everyone: From Messy Data to Useful Answers
targetAudience: Students from any major, including students with no programming experience.
learningOutcomes: Use AI to help understand an unfamiliar dataset.
Break a data problem into smaller steps.
Generate and run simple Python with AI assistance.
Ask useful questions of a dataset.
Explain what generated code is doing.
Recognize when AI-generated analysis may be wrong or misleading.
Complete a small data-analysis project largely through natural-language interaction with AI.
agenda: 20 minutes · 1. AI, Data, and Programming · What programming lets you do
20 minutes · 2. Meet the Dataset · Explore a messy student survey
30 minutes · 3. Your First AI-Assisted Program · Load, inspect, and summarize data
30 minutes · 4. Cleaning Real-World Data · Fix inconsistent and invalid values
30 minutes · 5. Asking Questions with Code · Statistics, grouping, comparisons
30 minutes · 6. Visualizing the Data · Charts and communicating findings
20 minutes · 7. Debugging and AI Skepticism · Break code, fix code, verify answers
20 minutes · 8. Student Mini-Project · Students investigate their own question
10 minutes · Wrap-up · Key lessons and next steps
